ModMetaData.name: Stand Painter
ModMetaData.author: MrBeverage
ModMetaData.description:
REQUIRES ODYSSEY (for the outfit stand).
Paint the apparel already ON an outfit stand. Select a stand, open its Paint tab, and recolour any held item — or the whole stand at once — with the full colour picker. No dressing a pawn first, no styling station, no dye.
Colours are ordinary base-game apparel colours: safe to add mid-save, and painted apparel keeps its colour even if you remove the mod.
Works on the vanilla and kid outfit stands, and on any modded stand built on the vanilla stand's behaviour.
